fluff.overview: Infantry within the Legiones Marianes form the backbone of planetary garrison and territorial defense, freeing the Hegemony's limited BattleMech assets for offensive operations and prestige assignments. A triplus contubernium, or triple tent-group, combines three squads of ten soldiers mounted on light vehicles. Motorized triplus contubernia provide fast-moving infantry support for Marian armored columns and conduct sweeps across open terrain where foot infantry cannot keep pace. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these formations field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
